title: Demo Tools
pageSubtitle: Minimal closed loop for a module: commands, events, intents, database and locale packs.
capability_desc: The demo_tools_* commands declared by this module are not yet part of the kernel's static generate_handler list (see docs/cgl-models.md 2.7.7 / 3.4). The page reports them as unavailable on purpose; do not treat the feature as ready.
capability_unknown_desc: No backend command has succeeded yet; the capability state is confirmed on the first request.
capability_available_desc: The backend commands responded successfully; module features are available.
error_not_registered: Command not registered: add-on module commands are not part of the kernel generate_handler list yet.
error_invoke_unavailable: Cannot reach the kernel: make sure the app runs inside the Tauri host.
overview_intents_empty: No intents are declared right now.
notes_empty_desc: Enter a title and body above and create the first note to verify the database path.
notes_form_hint: Title is required and limited to 120 characters.
activity_empty_desc: Run a ping or add and delete notes; module events appear here in real time.
kernel_event_hint: Demonstrates cross-module event consumption: kernel download state changes are shown here.
detail_missing_desc: The note may have been deleted, or the id does not belong to this module.
footer_note: Stage one ships as a source dependency; these features become truly available once the kernel supports add-on command registration.
